name: Re-leaf
source:
A guardian from the spirit world(oriental one) fell to the real world and into a weak/shy girl's body while chasing a thief. He has to collect some fire wheels and gem stones in order to find and confront the thief. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]

A demon and a shy high school girl change personalities, and deal with adapting to their new situations.
translation:
一名来自东方灵界的守护者追捕窃贼时坠入现实世界，并落进一名柔弱害羞少女的身体。为了找到窃贼并与之对决，他必须收集若干火轮和宝石。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]

一名恶魔与一名害羞的高中少女交换人格，并努力适应各自的新处境。
